purpose: Teach: スニーカー/きゅうり/太く/ねじ/子守/鈍感/包む/乗り場

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、新しい、本気で、絶対、スニーカー、絶対、お洒落だよね
lines.en: Riku, those new sneakers are actually really cool.
lines.style: Light, admiring tone. Quick, natural rhythm—the speed of a genuine compliment. Slight warmth underneath the casual delivery.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。給食の、本気で、絶対、きゅうり、絶対、サラダ、絶対、出たよな、桜
lines.en: Yeah. Remember when cucumber salad showed up at lunch that time?
lines.style: Soft, slightly distant. Searching for the memory. Quiet pace, as if half-talking to himself. Not quite landing on why he's bringing it up.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、最近、絶対、腕、絶対、太く、絶対、なってきたよね、リク
lines.en: You've actually gotten stronger lately—your arms, I mean.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation underneath mild teasing tone. Direct eye contact in the voice. The compliment lands heavier than the casual delivery would suggest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前の自転車、本気で、絶対、ねじ、絶対、しっかり、絶対、締めとけよ、桜
lines.en: Your bike's gotten loose—you need to tighten up those bolts properly, Sakura.
lines.style: Practical concern wrapped in quietness. Not worried-sounding, but attentive. The kind of thing he notices and mentions because it matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 妹の、本気で、絶対、子守、絶対、私、絶対、お母さんに、絶対、頼まれちゃったよ、リク
lines.en: I got roped into babysitting my little sister—Mom asked me.
lines.style: Slightly resigned but not actually bothered. Dry, matter-of-fact rhythm. The exhale of someone who knew this was coming.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、本気で、絶対、雰囲気の変化、絶対、鈍感、絶対、なところ、絶対、あるよな、桜
lines.en: You know, you're actually kind of oblivious to stuff sometimes.
lines.style: Gentle observation delivered with a small, knowing smile in the voice. Not accusatory—affectionate teasing. Pace stays even and warm.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: お前への、本気で、絶対、お土産、絶対、私、絶対、可愛く、絶対、包む、絶対、ね、リク
lines.en: I got you something while I was out—wrapped it nicely.
lines.style: Soft voice. Small smile underneath. Slightly self-conscious about the care she put into it, but not hiding it. Warm, unguarded moment.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 駅前の、本気で、絶対、バス乗り場、絶対、いつも、絶対、混んでるぜ、桜
lines.en: That bus stop near the station gets crazy crowded every time.
lines.style: Idle observation, almost thinking out loud. Conversational, no particular emotion. The kind of thing you mention to keep talking, to stay close.
